gizmo.title: Tūtohi rēta
gizmo.description: Tūtohi rēta (pūngāwerewere) mō ngā tauira pakeketanga me te kaute āhuatanga, pērā i HEOSAT. Kei roto he kuputuhi kē me tētahi ripanga raraunga.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te upoko mō te tūtohi; ka whakamahia hoki hei ingoa wātea mōna.

configure.title: Kaute mōrahi
configure.description: Te uara teitei rawa i te āwhata.

configure.title: Ngā kāwai
configure.description: Kotahi te kāwai mō ia rārangi. Me 3 neke atu.

configure.title: Ngā kaute
configure.description: Ngā tau kua wehea ki te piko, kotahi mō ia kāwai i te raupapa ōrite.

configure.title: Ngā kaute whāinga
configure.description: Ngā tau kua wehea ki te piko, kotahi mō ia kāwai i te raupapa ōrite.

configure.title: Whakaatu kī
configure.description: Whakaaturia he kī e whakaingoa ana i ngā kaute me ngā whāinga.

configure.title: Kiato
configure.description: He tūtohi iti ake kāore he tapanga, kī, ripanga raraunga rānei. Tau te kiore ki runga i tētahi pūwāhi kia kite i ōna uara.

advanced.title: Tapanga kaute
advanced.description: Te tapanga kī me te ripanga mō ngā kaute.

advanced.title: Tapanga whāinga
advanced.description: Te tapanga kī me te ripanga mō ngā whāinga.
